# Site assets

- `wordmark-original.png`: unchanged copy of `brand-reference/png/SERIF 2.png`.
- `passport-original.png`: unchanged copy of `brand-reference/png/PASSPORTS GRAPHIC.png`.
- The inline header SVG is a fitted viewport around the original logo, with an SVG color filter mapping its ink to the confirmed navy. No logo paths, proportions, or source pixels were edited.
- `favicon.svg` embeds that same original PNG and frames its first Z glyph. Its background and ink use the confirmed cream and navy.
- `z-for-zephyr-original.png`: unchanged copy of `brand-reference/png/Z FOR ZEPHYR.png`, visually compared with the merged `Z FOR ZEPHYR.psd` artwork. The browser uses the transparent export because it needs no Photoshop support. A fitted SVG viewport and navy color filter preserve the graphic's contours. CSS rotates front and back copies in perspective; this is not a volumetric mesh.
- The passport image is retained as an unused original asset; the compact revision no longer displays it.
- The Fenway and beach photos (from `IMG_1796.jpeg`, `IMG_3154.heic`, `IMG_3152.heic`) were removed from the page and this folder on 2026-10-30 at the user's request; their originals in Downloads are unchanged.
- `lifestyle-tote.jpg`: 508×635 JPEG (quality 95) from a 512×640 photo the user supplied in chat on 2026-10-30 (blue cap, black hoodie, canvas tote, from behind). The bottom 5 rows and 4 columns were trimmed to keep exactly 4:5. It is the left home page photo.
- `lifestyle-harbor.jpg`: 1400×1750 JPEG (quality 82) resized from a 4640×5800 photo the user supplied in chat on 2026-10-30 (standing above the harbor).
- These two photos lead the page directly under the red brand banner. They were resized only; keep the full-resolution originals outside this folder.
- `hat-blue.jpg` and `hat-white-red.jpg`: 1200×1600 JPEGs (quality 88) made from 1890×1417 front-view hat photos the user supplied in chat (blue on 2026-10-30; white-and-red replaced on 2026-11-01 with a sharper photo in which the hat is larger, so it is enlarged less). Each hat was trimmed, scaled to the same width (74% of the canvas), and centered; the white background was multiplied onto the tile tone #F0EFEB, with a 6% contrast lift. Keep the full-resolution originals outside this folder.
- Hat 02 gallery (`hat-02.html`), all from photos the user supplied in chat on 2026-10-30:
  - `hat-white-red-side.jpg`: 1200×1600 (quality 88) from a 1890×1417 side-view product photo, processed like the front shot (trimmed, centered, background multiplied onto #F0EFEB, 6% contrast). The side profile is scaled to 84% of the canvas width so its height stays below the front shot's.
  - `hat-white-red-traps.jpg`: 1200×1500 (quality 85), the full 4316×5395 lobster-traps photo resized.
  - `hat-white-red-pub.jpg`: 1200×1500 (quality 85), a 4:5 crop (rows 700–6500) of a 4640×6960 pub photo.
  - `hat-white-red-beach.jpg`: 1200×1500 (quality 85), a 4:5 crop (bottom 5800 rows) of a 4640×6960 beach photo.
- Hat 01 gallery (`hat-01.html`), all from photos the user supplied in chat on 2026-10-30:
  - `hat-blue-side.jpg`: 1200×1600 (quality 88) from a 1890×1417 side-view product photo, processed like the front shot and scaled to 84% of the canvas width, matching `hat-white-red-side.jpg`.
  - `hat-blue-harbor.jpg`, `hat-blue-street.jpg`, `hat-blue-surf.jpg`: 1200×1500 (quality 85), full-height 4:5 crops (3712×4640, starting at x = 1312, 1346, and 2147) of 6960×4640 photos, framed on the subject.
- Three-quarter product shots (gallery photo 2), from 1890×1417 photos the user supplied in chat on 2026-10-30, processed like the other product shots and fitted inside the shared product box (at most 1008 px wide and 712 px tall on the 1200×1600 canvas):
  - `hat-blue-angle.jpg`: before processing, a patch of white mesh texture and purple specks under the back of the crown (source x 405–570, y 880–990) was painted to background with a 2 px feathered edge.
  - `hat-white-red-angle.jpg`: no retouching.
- `about-harbor.jpg`: 1200×1500 (quality 85), a 4:5 crop (rows 900–6700) of a 4640×6960 harbor photo the user supplied in chat on 2026-10-30. It is the About page photo, replacing the lobster-traps photo there (that photo is still used in the Hat 02 gallery).
- `hat-white-red-lifestyle.jpg`: 1200×1500 (quality 85), resized from a 3935×4919 photo the user supplied in chat on 2026-11-01 (white-and-red cap, red chore coat, lobster traps). It is now the only lifestyle photo in the Hat 02 gallery; `hat-white-red-traps.jpg`, `hat-white-red-pub.jpg`, and `hat-white-red-beach.jpg` were taken out of the gallery at the user's request and are kept, unused.
- 2026-11-01: `hat-blue-angle.jpg` was replaced with a cleaner three-quarter photo the user supplied (1890×1417, no mesh patch, so no retouching), processed the same way. The Hat 01 gallery is now front, three-quarter, side, and harbor; `hat-blue-street.jpg` and `hat-blue-surf.jpg` were taken out of the gallery at the user's request and are kept, unused.
